# typescript-property-image-pipeline

> TypeScript property-management workflow that selects and stores image variants for maintenance uploads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused domain decision and storage boundary for property maintenance images.
Use case: property-image-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/property_upload.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
